# About datapack / mod This project is formerly known as "Raw Ore to Blocks" Efficient Raw Ore Blocks Smelting allows you to smelt and blast **Raw Ore Blocks** saving you a little bit of time and fuel when you have a ton of ore to smelt. It was mainly created to speed up the process of smelting **copper**, as there's always a ton of it, but it also works with **iron** and **gold**. There's also a few add-on avaliable that adds the ability to smelt raw ore blocks from other mods. To find out more, check out my profile where you can find all my projects, along with those add-ons. ## Feature balancing I didn't want this datapack / mod to be overpowered, so there are two things I did to balance it and keep that Vanilla-like experience. - Smelting Raw Ore Block takes the same time as smelting **8 single raw ores** saving your time by one ingot per block. (1600 ticks in the furnace, 800 ticks in the blast furnace). It also ensures that you will use only **one piece of coal for every block smelted**, so you're saving one coal piece per 8 smelted block. - Smelting Raw Ore Block gives you the same amount of EXP as smelting **9 single raw ores** so you're not losing any experience. ## Recipes This datapack / mod adds **6** new recipes that allow you to smelt raw ore blocks — 3 recipes for the furnace and 3 for the blast furnace. ![Minecraft recipe showing a process of blasting raw ore block of copper](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c471b0986c8690ccc4d5917efea3e1d703199f48.png) ## Advancements This datapack / mod comes with 4 new advancements. 3 of them will **reward** you for smelting raw ore blocks with some additional experience points. ![Minecraft advancement called "Efficient way to smelt copper" with a copper block icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/39527bcb2810304f39d3388a880ee22b712a0175.png) ## Translations Datapack / mod supports following languages: English Polish ## Future project support I plan on updating this project once new **full** releases of Minecraft comes out. ## Compatibility with other projects If you want some extra compatibility for ores introduced with **other mods**, let me know on **[Discord](https://discord.gg/DGVD6wBTDF)** and I will release additional add-ons giving compatibility with desired mods! ## Check out my other projects on my [profile](https://modrinth.com/user/Syhmac)!
